column3: Which part of a config does a plain `while IFS= read -r` loop lose, and what does src/parser/parse.sh do about it?
column6: The last line when it has no trailing newline; parse.sh loops with `read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]` so it is still processed.

column3: Why must parse.sh emit `key=value` without spaces, and what consumes its output?
column6: releasekit-agent splits on the first = without trimming, so spaces become part of the key and value (RB-659).

column3: Against what directory is an @include path resolved, and why does the cwd not work?
column6: Relative to the including file (RB-655); the agent runs the parser from / so the cwd is never the config directory.

column3: How many levels may includes nest, and what happens past the limit?
column6: 3 levels; deeper than that parse.sh exits 7 with `include depth exceeds 3 (RB-661)`.
